[Email ComplianceCounselLLC → Dr.Santos Thu May 28 08:00 EDT 2026] Subject: Formal Compliance Opinion — ProBio+ Daily Launch Review

Dear Dr. Santos,

We have completed our initial review of the ProBio+ Daily launch materials. Summary of findings:

1. 'Clinically demonstrated to support immune function' — PROHIBITED. Requires at least one well-controlled RCT for the specific product blend. The existing LGG-only RCTs do not support a product-level 'clinically demonstrated' claim.

2. 'May help support immune function' — WARNING. While softening language, 'may' is specifically identified in FTC Health Products Compliance Guidance as an insufficient qualifier for emerging science claims.

3. 'Doctor-formulated' claim — CONDITIONALLY PERMITTED. This claim is conditionally permissible provided: (a) the physician actually participated in formulation; (b) there is adequate substantiation for the claimed benefits; (c) any material connection is disclosed per §255.5.

4. 'Results not typical' disclaimer [OUTDATED GUIDANCE REFERENCE BELOW] — Under Section 255.1(b) of the 2009 Endorsement Guides, the 'results not typical' disclaimer provides safe harbor for atypical testimonials. [NOTE: This reference to the 2009 Guides is included in error — see our corrected opinion letter v2 for the current standard.]

5. 'Made in USA' — HIGH RISK. The Danish-sourced Chr. Hansen probiotic strains are key functional components. The 'all or virtually all' standard is unlikely to be satisfied. We recommend a qualified claim.

Regards,
Compliance Counsel LLC

Received Compliance Counsel LLC initial opinion. Key observations: Points 1, 2, 3, and 5 align with current FTC guidance. IMPORTANT FLAG: Point 4 cites the 2009 Endorsement Guides' 'results not typical' safe harbor — this guidance is OUTDATED. The safe harbor was abolished in 2009 and does not exist under the current 2023 Endorsement Guides (§255.1). The external auditors note themselves this is an error ('see our corrected opinion letter v2'). This recommendation must be placed in 'superseded_recommendations' pending the v2 corrected letter.
